prompt: Edit Image 1, the NPC081 eye reference grid. Return exactly one 2×2 sprite atlas, same 1024×560 canvas and same four equal cells, no text or labels. Repeat-open should visually match open. Use soft muted colors and pixel clusters from the original art; no blur, no harsh contrast, no black eyeliner or thick brow bars, no extra orange skin, no face repaint, no shifted gaze, no altered hair or head geometry. Output must remain crisp native pixel art enlarged in each cell, with cell boundaries and source framing unchanged.
